name: Wicks Farm Holiday Park
accommodation: 40 electric pitches and camping pods sleeping up to 4
parking: One car per pitch; visitor car park
dogs: Dogs welcome on leads on pitches; limited dog-friendly pods
beachAccess: About 2 miles to West Wittering beach; under 3 miles to East Wittering and Bracklesham
confirmedFeatures: Amenities block, laundrette, camp kitchen, pods with fridge and heater
overview: A campsite on Redlands Lane, West Wittering, around two miles from West Wittering beach and under three from East Wittering and Bracklesham. It has 40 electric pitches and camping pods, plus a camp kitchen and laundrette.
surfTripFit: Sits between all three Witterings beaches, so you can drive to whichever is working.
